data.rationale: Greater Sooty Owls are renowned for their exceptionally silent flight and precise, deadly ambush attacks in dense, shadowy forests, perfectly embodying the deathtouch and flying abilities. Their dark, almost black plumage aligns with black mana, while their elusive, intelligent nature and keen nocturnal senses represent gaining insight or knowledge upon arrival, fitting the 'draw a card' effect and the cunning of blue mana.
